source.comparison: All four complete parsed UI objects match local native ui.brarchive and official full ZIP. All15 PNGs match the native textures/ui.brarchive, full ZIP, and pinned official HTTP raw bytes; no assertion is inferred from filenames.

coordinateConvention: Rectangles are[x,y,width,height], root-relative game pixels. CSS uses2x each coordinate without independent integer rounding. Final native renderer snapping is not proved.

smithing.profile: Modern three-input smithing_table_2_screen.json. Legacy smithing_table_screen.json is a different two-input layout and is not silently substituted.

icon.note: smithing_icon physical30x30; unlike the15x15 anvil_icon, it enlarges by2x at GUI2.

title.note: Box geometry is source-derived; normal-font glyph baseline within this short label box remains a Web-profile choice.

recipeGrid.formula: recipe_panel size[100%,90%], left_middle anchors; nine columns give18game cell width.

slots.formula: Fixed18game common.container_item centers in grid columns0,1,2,5; y=36.67+(37.26-18)/2. Result is normal18, not large26.

arrowAndInvalid.formula: yields at grid column3 x61, size[22.2%,100%] interpreted against162game grid =>35.964game span. Center18x12 image gives x61+(35.964-18)/2. This percentage span needs final native capture; it is retained rather than rounded to36game.
arrowAndInvalid.invalid: cross_out_icon_button visible from #cross_out_icon; it overlays the existing arrow. Caller invalid guards result taking.

preview.formula: result_item_preview at column7 (x133), inner25x25 centers within18x37.26 with offset[2,0].
preview.implementation: Empty native-sized slot when preview is omitted; caller may supply a renderer through preview. No invented equipment image or simulated3D model.

underlays.geometry: source smithing_image top_left offset[1,1], size16x16. ItemSlot underlay always remains below actual item art, including occupied slots; it is not the faded generic empty placeholder.
underlays.visibility: Source exposes #show_input_overlay_templates, #show_input_overlay_armors_and_tools, #show_input_overlay_armors, #show_material_overlay_all and #show_material_overlay_ingot, without JSON expressions for their values. Native empty screenshot confirms only the template overlay. Defaults are templateOverlaytrue,baseOverlaynull,materialOverlaynull; caller explicitly supplies other visibility states from the actual template/backend. The component does not infer recipe eligibility or binding values.
underlays.sourceAnimation: All animated strips use16x16game UV, fps1, frame_step0. Actual PNGs are horizontal strips:32/64/192/112x16, not vertical.
underlays.webAnimation: A32CSS square viewport crops full-size horizontal strips using one source frame each second. overlayFrame freezes a finite floored frame modulo frame count; NaN/infinities freeze frame0. Reduced motion stops animation at frame0 unless a caller selected a fixed frame.
underlays.limits: Native flip-book start phase and frame_step interpretation are not engine-capture verified; exact crops are independently testable.

smithing.invalidTooltip: Source common.hover_text is custom hover_text_renderer with max width500game. invalidReason is exposed as the invalid marker accessible label; no browser-native tooltip or fabricated source renderer is substituted.

cartography.profile: Classic cartography main panel at the source large-viewport maximum176x220game. Source root uses size[100%-44px,100%] with max_size[176,220]; the component fixes this maximum profile inside the existing scroll wrapper. Compact game viewport reflow is not implemented or claimed.
cartography.normalFontProfile: Source title and MapName labels have natural normal-font heights. The Web stack model uses10game/20CSS label line boxes, consistent with existing Mojangles profile, not a native measured height.

stackModel.formula: Fixed total130game equals top height at220game root. Name/title baseline and stack anchor behavior need native capture.

mapNameLabel.textAlignment: left; confirmed by the GUI5 Chinese native capture, where the Map Name label starts at approximately x881, aligned with the name field left edge, rather than centered.

nameField.source: cartography.text_edit_control sets size[default,20], label size[default,10], max_length30; it has no visibility binding and is always part of the source stack.
nameField.text: common.text_edit_box white normal-font text, shadowfalse, centering_panel[100%-6px,100%-4px]; GUI2 text strip horizontal6px inset and20px height. Placeholder binding #text_box_placeholder_name is passed as renamePlaceholder. Caller controls renameDisabled/renameReadOnly/name/onNameChange.

main.formula: main width162 centered in164wide top; height100%cm=max(66map,57inputstack,26result,13arrows). y depends on normal10game label profile above.

map.source: map_image_panel66x66, center anchors. Every mode uses the actual66x66 Mojang image, not a reconstructed terrain/map renderer.

slots.formula: input_slots stack heights18+(13+8)+18=57, center in66=>y58.5. Native GUI5 capture shows input top440 and additional top635, corresponding to58.5/97.5game after native pixel rounding. Unlike a normal panel, this vertical stack does not apply the source child main-axis offsets+1/-1. The previous59.5/96.5 source-only interpretation was disproved by this capture. Result26game remains right_middle in main162x66.

arrows.texture: arrow.png physical16x13; source main overrides the generic22x15 arrow size to16x13.

description.source: output_description_label size[100%,10], text_alignmentcenter, text #output_description, anchors bottom_middle -> top_middle.
description.evidence: Native stack-panel anchor resolution is not established by source alone. Web implementation uses the allocated row immediately after main, marked data-fidelity=stack-anchor-unverified. Its y120 is NOT a certified native coordinate; independent QA should not certify this position as a game pixel match.

inventory.formula: Bottom inventory-with-label is fixed93game: label=rootHeight-93+3, grid=rootHeight-80, hotbar=rootHeight-23.

cartography.resultState: Source has no cartography crossout control. Caller supplies resultAvailable to guard unavailable results, while an empty ResultSlot also guards itself. No fabricated invalid icon or automatic map rule is introduced.

sharedBehavior.state: All item/result/name/mode/overlay visibility data and operation callbacks are caller-controlled. Neither component computes recipes, consumes inputs, modifies maps, or generates renderable equipment.
sharedBehavior.closeButtons: Both source main panels set show_close_buttonfalse and use separate external toolbar/tab chrome. Public props omit onClose/closeLabel; runtime overrides onCloseundefined after forwarded props to prevent accidental internal X. External chrome is outside this main-panel profile.
sharedBehavior.normalFont: Existing var(--mc-font-size)/--mc-font controls typography. Absolute native normal scale, glyph baseline and default texture pixel snapping still require game capture.

verification.coreTypeScript: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit passed after both components.
verification.independentQa: Before the native corrections, the independent combined source-material/profile run passed31/31, including15special cases. That result did not detect the backend default visibility or stack-axis offset differences; targeted post-correction validation is recorded separately.
verification.nativeCorrectionFollowup: 16/16 special-only browser tests passed in28.3s on an isolated5189server/output, including default template-only visibility, corrected58.5/97.5game slot positions, left-aligned Map Name, both source UV frames and all seven original map modes. Integrated npm run typecheck passed. No repeat of the full301-test integration suite was needed. These tests validate the narrow corrections and source image rendering, not whole native-screen equality.

evidenceLimits: Byte-equal materials and algebraically source-derived boxes do not constitute whole-screen native GPU verification.

Empty native screenshots corroborate selected grid/stack/main-box landmarks, but do not prove all nested anchor behavior, native normal-font glyph metrics, pixel snapping or the blank output-description position.
The equipment_preview_renderer and hover_text_renderer are custom engine paths. Only explicit renderer slots/accessibility text are provided; their appearance is not claimed.
Compact cartography viewport layout and external toolbar/tab/help chrome are outside these fixed main-panel profiles.
Lossless native empty smithing/cartography references were captured on 2026-10-29; this does not establish complete native-screen equality.

nativeEmptyStateEvidence.smithing: Native empty state shows the template ghost and flat empty base/material slots. This establishes the default empty visibility only, not values of every backend binding for occupied/invalid templates.

cartography.method: Read original lossless PNG pixels. The66game map texture is330screen pixels; its top-left approximately1126,417 fixes panel origin approximately851,147 at GUI5. Fractional slot positions may round at the native raster boundary; this is landmark validation, not full RGBA equality.
cartography.correction: Stack input y58.5 and additional y97.5 fit the native pixel edges; applying source offsets+1/-1 would predict approximately445/630 and is wrong by5screen pixels each. WebGUI2 local slot top values are9/87CSS, rather than11/85.
cartography.label: Map Name is left-aligned with the text field in the native image.
cartography.unchanged: Map132CSS square, name field, result52CSS square, arrows, inventory and hotbar major boxes remain consistent with the existing large-viewport profile.
cartography.description: No description text is visible in the empty native screenshot, so the description stack anchor remains unverified.

nativeEmptyStateEvidence.scope: Confirms only empty-state visibility and the stated local geometry/alignment. It does not establish matching language glyphs, native font baseline, custom renderer output, occupied states, compact viewport behavior or whole-screen pixel equality.
